hook: Retail inflation hits *6.09%*, above RBI's limit
hook_b: Retail inflation hits *6.09%*, above RBI's limit
tldr: CPI inflation crossed the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit in October, raising expectations of a December rate hike.

beats.what: Prices rose in 11 of 12 major CPI categories; sugar, confectionery and desserts hit 13%, per Hindustan Times.
beats.why: Both food and non-food prices pushed inflation up; it has risen every month since November 2025.
beats.care: Your grocery, eating-out and EMI costs are linked: higher prices now, and a rate hike would make loans dearer.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Core inflation stood at 4.6%, per CMIE data cited by HT.

cards.q: Where are rising prices hitting you most?

qs: How much of the rise is weather-driven versus lasting?
Would a rate hike cool food prices?

facts.t: RBI's MPC projects headline inflation at *5.2%* for FY27.
Inflation had already crossed RBI's *4%* target in June.

viz.verdict: Food prices rising faster for everyone buying them

watch: RBI's December policy meeting, where economists expect a rate hike.

sources.name: Hindustan Times
sources.title: Inflation tops RBI's 6% ceiling, raises December rate hike prospects

fact: India's retail inflation hits *6.09%*, a two-year high above RBI's limit.
twist: Food and beverages, *37%* of the basket, rose to *8.51%*; the figure was just 2.1% in January.
